title: Landing pages: 9 elements that turn visits into enquiries
excerpt: Sending traffic to a page without one clear action wastes opportunity. Here is a landing-page formula for local businesses in Montenegro.
description: Sending traffic to a page without one clear action wastes opportunity. Here is a landing-page formula for local businesses in Montenegro.
coverAlt: Landing page that converts visits into enquiries
segments: A landing page must immediately answer: who are you, where are you, what do you offer and what should I do now? The elements most likely to increase enquiries are an H1 mentioning the service and location, one offer, one CTA, proof above the fold, a three-step process, an FAQ, local signals (Podgorica/Montenegro), fast loading and readable mobile design.
